sourceRefs.locator: Personal recollection beginning Quem condigne laudare; trilingual writing in Et haec omnia; seven years, expulsion, reception under Constantius and crossing of the Danube in Ubi et post multorum.
Opening section Wulfila, excerpt of Philostorgius, Ecclesiastical History 2.5 in Photius’ epitome, followed by the conditional calculation of 347–348.
pp. 52–54, especially p. 53 on the 340s persecution, reception under Constantius, vicinity of Nicopolis ad Istrum, and the later crossing in 376.

summary.de: Christen, die mit ihrem Bischof während der Herrschaft von Constantius II. die Donau überschritten. Ihre Aufnahme liegt vor der Flucht von 376.
summary.en: Christians who crossed the Danube with their bishop in the reign of Constantius II. Their reception predates the flight of 376.
